Services & Prices

Everything your smile needs, priced upfront

No hidden charges. The price you see here is the price you confirm with the doctor before any treatment begins. Final cost is always explained in writing first.

Checkup & Consultation

Full mouth examination, digital X-ray review and a written treatment plan with exact costs — no obligation to proceed.

৳500 / visitBook →

Scaling & Polishing

Ultrasonic cleaning removes plaque, tartar and tea/coffee stains, finished with a smooth polish. Recommended every 6 months.

৳1,500 / full mouthBook →

Teeth Whitening

Professional laser whitening, up to 5 shades brighter in a single 60-minute sitting. Safe for enamel, with sensitivity care included.

৳6,000 / sessionBook →

Tooth Filling

Tooth-coloured composite filling that matches your natural shade. Cavity cleaned and sealed in one visit, with a 1-year warranty.

৳1,800 / toothBook →

Root Canal Treatment

Painless single-visit rotary root canal in most cases. Saves your natural tooth and ends deep toothache for good.

Crowns & Bridges

Strong, natural-looking zirconia and ceramic crowns that protect weak teeth and restore your bite. 5-year warranty.

Braces & Aligners

Metal, ceramic and clear-aligner options to straighten teeth at any age. Free first orthodontic assessment, monthly payment plan available.

Kids' Dentistry

Why BrightSmile

Dentistry that starts with listening, not drilling

  • Price first, treatment secondYou approve a written estimate before we begin. If anything changes mid-treatment, we stop and tell you first.
  • Genuinely painless techniqueTopical gel before every injection, slow delivery and breaks whenever you raise a hand. Most patients say they felt nothing.
  • Sterilisation you can seeSealed instrument pouches are opened in front of you. Four-step sterilisation, every single patient, no exceptions.
  • We save teeth, not sell treatmentIf a tooth can be saved with a ৳1,800 filling, we will never push a ৳8,500 crown. Your long-term cost matters to us.

Common Questions

Before you visit

Does the treatment hurt?

Almost never. We apply numbing gel before any injection, use slow-delivery technique, and pause whenever you raise a hand. Root canals and fillings at BrightSmile are known for being painless — most patients are surprised at how easy it was.

How will I know the exact cost before treatment?

After your checkup (৳500), the doctor writes down your full treatment plan with the exact price of each step. Nothing begins until you approve it, and the price does not change afterwards. If a surprise appears mid-treatment, we stop and discuss first.

Do I need an appointment, or can I walk in?

Walk-ins are welcome, but booked patients are seen first — booking on WhatsApp takes 30 seconds and guarantees your slot. For severe toothache, call us and we will fit you into the same-day emergency slot.

How often should I get my teeth cleaned?

Every 6 months for most people. Scaling and polishing (৳1,500) removes tartar that brushing cannot, prevents gum disease and keeps your breath fresh. If you smoke or drink a lot of tea, every 4 months is better.

Can I pay in instalments for braces or implants?

Yes. Braces are naturally paid monthly as treatment progresses, and 0% EMI is available on any treatment above ৳20,000 via card or bKash arrangements. Ask at reception for the current plan.

Do you treat children?

Yes — Dr. Fatema specialises in children's dentistry. Kids' checkups are ৳800, parents can stay in the room, and we use a gentle, play-first approach so children leave smiling, not scared.
